Crystalline Crawler has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.

description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G/U}.

Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanent(s).
